# Getting here

Hotel Lärchenwald is at Via da Fex 7, 7514 Sils Maria, a five-minute walk from the village square.

## By train and PostBus

Take the Rhaetian Railway to St. Moritz. There, board PostBus line 4 to the stop “Sils/Segl Maria, Posta”. You will find the timetable at [SBB](https://www.sbb.ch/en/).

## By car

From the north, drive over the Julier Pass; from the south, over the Maloja Pass. The hotel has 12 parking spaces, at CHF 15 per day.
